types.name: GcwRegion
types.description: A GCW score category — a "contested region" when region-backed — joining the static config from gcw_score_category with the live faction control scores from the Tatooine PlanetObject. This is the region/faction control board, distinct from the per-player `gcwOfficers` ranking.

fields.name: categoryName
fields.description: CategoryName — the join key, and the objvar suffix (`gcwScore.Imp.<categoryName>`). e.g. `gcw_region_tatooine_1`, `tatooine_pve`.

fields.name: centerX
fields.description: World-space centre X of the contested circle, from the region datatable. Null when the category isn't region-backed or the region geometry isn't bundled.

fields.name: centerZ
fields.description: World-space centre Z of the contested circle. Null when not region-backed / geometry unavailable.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Human-readable region label for tooltips/lists (`gcw_regions.stf`), e.g. "Bestine Frontier"; a title-cased CategoryName when the STF has no entry.

fields.name: groups
fields.description: Composite group memberships (GcwGroup1..5), blanks dropped — e.g. `galaxy`, `tatooine`.

fields.name: isContested
fields.description: GcwRegionDefender — true when the region is contested/defendable.

fields.name: isRegionBacked
fields.description: Whether this category is backed by a circular region of geometry (RegionPlanet non-empty). This is the real gate for "has geometry", not the `gcw_region_` name prefix.

fields.name: notifyOnChange
fields.description: NotifyOnPercentileChange — whether the game fires a faction notification on a control flip.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: Radius of the contested circle in world units. Null when not region-backed / geometry unavailable.

fields.name: regionPlanet
fields.description: Scene the region lives in (RegionPlanet). Null/blank ⇒ an abstract category with no geometry.

fields.name: score
fields.description: Live score and derived percentiles for this category.

fields.name: scoreWeight
fields.description: CategoryScoreWeight — weight in the composite group score (e.g. 100000 ground, 500000 space).

types.name: GcwScore

fields.name: rebelPercent

types.name: __Type

The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name, description and optional `specifiedByURL`, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.
